plays_on: browsers, on a computer or a phone — loads at once, shared by a link (itch.io, any web host)
choose.suits: small 2D games written all in code, no editor to install; physics, tilemaps and the like are written or brought in as libraries; reaching a store needs a wrapper the kit does not set up
choose.pick_when: it is played in a browser only, is 2D and small (minutes a session, a jam game, something to share by link)
